title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Provisions of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China Concerning Other Invoices for Export Tax Rebates and Tax Deductions

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, based on situations encountered in judicial practice, discussed the meaning of "other invoices for export tax refunds and tax deductions" as provided in the Criminal Law, and hereby gives the following interpretation:
The "other invoices for export tax refunds and tax deductions" as provided in the Criminal Law refer to receipts, payment vouchers, or tax payment certificates that have the function of export tax refunds and tax deductions, other than special VAT invoices.
This is hereby announced.
